adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Admin::GroupsController` uses `Group.find(...)` in `update`, `destroy`, `add_members`, and `remove_member` (e.g., `Group.find(params.require(:group_id).to_i)`), which will raise `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound` for invalid IDs unless the app globally rescues it to a 404—this is an edge-case/behavioral concern but not provably broken from the diff alone. Also, `remove_member` does `group.users.delete(user_id)` and then returns `success_json` if `group.save` succeeds; `delete` is effectively idempotent, so removing a non-member will still return success, which may or may not be desired but is exactly what the code does.
